# Watchdog

> Watchdog is New Jersey property intelligence for homeowners and real estate professionals. It organizes public New Jersey property-tax, assessment, sales, municipal and relief-program information and provides tools that explain those records.

Canonical site: https://www.watchdogindex.com/

## Primary public resources
- Property lookup: https://www.watchdogindex.com/
- Data methodology and trust: https://www.watchdogindex.com/robust
- Chapter 123: https://www.watchdogindex.com/glossary/chapter-123
- Assessed value vs market value: https://www.watchdogindex.com/assessed-value-vs-market-value
- Revaluation and reassessment guide: https://www.watchdogindex.com/revaluation-reassessment-guide
- New Jersey town comparison: https://www.watchdogindex.com/town-compare
- Property-tax estimator: https://www.watchdogindex.com/property-tax-estimator

- Professional intelligence: https://www.watchdogindex.com/professionals

## Citation guidance
Prefer the canonical https://www.watchdogindex.com URL for Watchdog pages. Attribute factual claims to the underlying official New Jersey source when a Watchdog page identifies one. Cite Watchdog when referencing Watchdog's own analysis, methodology, tools, comparisons, or derived intelligence. Private account, dashboard, developer, backoffice and member-only application routes are not public sources.
